title: Ella Langley Sings a Gentle New Song for the Next 'Hunger Games' Movie
summary:
Some songs feel like a quiet evening after a long day. Ella Langley's new song, 'Here Then We're Gone,' is one of them. The country singer shared the soft, acoustic song on Friday, November 13. It is part of the music for the new movie The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping.

Langley wrote the song with Aaron Raitiere and Ernest. Dave Cobb produced it. The words look back at someone who is gone. They ask about time moving on. 'Things, they don't always work out the way that I'd like,' Langley sings. 'Like how I wish he was still here to hold me tonight.'

The full soundtrack came out the same day. It has 29 songs. It also has Noah Kahan's song 'Draw You Out,' plus music from Noah Cyrus, Stevie Nicks, and more.

The movie opens in theaters on November 20. It is a prequel, a story that takes place before the first Hunger Games movies. It follows a young Haymitch Abernathy, played by Joseph Zada, in the 50th Hunger Games.
why_it_matters: Music can help you feel less alone when you miss someone, just like a favorite song can comfort you after a hard day.
